card.triceratops: I'm a Triceratops! I have three horns on my face, and a big frill behind my head. I'm a herbivore. That means I only eat plants!
card.trex: Roar! I'm a T-Rex! I have huge teeth, and tiny little arms. I'm a carnivore. That means I eat meat!
card.pteranodon: I'm a Terodactyl! I have big wings, and I can fly high up in the sky. I swoop down to catch fish with my long beak!
card.stegosaurus: I'm a Stegosaurus! I have big plates along my back, and spikes on my tail. I'm a herbivore. That means I only eat plants!
card.brachiosaurus: I'm a Brachiosaurus! My neck is super long, so I can reach the leaves at the very top of the trees. I'm a herbivore. I only eat plants!
card.plesiosaurus: I'm a Plesiosaurus! I live in the water, and I swim with my four flippers. I love to eat fish!
card.turtle: I'm a Sea Turtle! I carry my shell everywhere I go. It keeps me safe. I paddle with my flippers, and I munch on sea plants!
win: You found all seven of your friends! Well done!
